status: IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE 0.2.13 / code 16; hand aiming and pinch on both platforms; 208 EditMode and 157 PlayMode passed; both APKs audited; worn-headset acceptance PENDING.
user_requirement: Keep hand tracking and improve its stability. The user explicitly rejected the 0.2.12 head-dwell workaround.
supersedes: PicoMenuRecoveryFix.json / 0.2.12. Do not distribute the 0.2.12 head-dwell APK as this fix.
input_contract: Both platforms use hand aiming and a fresh thumb-index pinch. Looking at a button, holding a pinch from a previous page, or recovering with closed fingers cannot click it. There is no head-dwell route.

changes.rule: The PICO portable rig reads Dynamic XRHandSubsystem updates and each required joint's TryGetPose result directly. It binds when a running subsystem becomes available and can rebind after stop/restart. SDK pointer validity, pointer objects and Hand.WhenHandUpdated are not prerequisites for portable aiming. Missing native joints cannot be replaced by cached SDK joint values.

Wrist, index-base and thumb-base poses determine pointing. Thumb/index fingertip validity determines whether pinch is available. Missing fingertips keep a valid live aim visible but clear click rearm; they are not treated as open fingers. Native tracking loss, missing aiming joints, stopped updates and system ownership suppress input. Freshness allows current/previous frame for update ordering, with an 80 ms wall-time ceiling, and explicit lost/invalid updates clear immediately.

The camp displays valid hand rays even before a button is found, including when fingers are closed. A tracked closed hand may aim but must reopen before clicking. Fireground retains contextual rays. A 16 mm retention margin keeps an already acquired button stable under small open-hand jitter; the existing 22 mm closing-pinch retention remains. New target acquisition retains the 12 mm margin and eligibility rules.

Portable aim uses independent per-hand One Euro filters and frame-time-scaled pinch damping. Focus and pause remain independent gates. Valid visual hands are separate from system-owned interaction input. Neither render-only snapshots nor missing finger data are used for gameplay actions.

verification_scope: Editor tests exercise native-sample validity/freshness, transforms, filtered aim, actual menu colliders, hand-specific pinch, page/focus recovery, scene transitions and existing gameplay. They do not exercise a real PICO sensor/provider or establish worn-headset usability/performance.
device_acceptance: PENDING; tester PICO model and OS unknown
system_menu_policy: System menus are not disabled. The fix keeps hand interaction and rejects system-owned gestures instead of replacing hand tracking.
